entities.name: Feliciano de la Vega Padilla

entities.summary: Feliciano de la Vega Padilla was a Roman Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Mexico (1638–1640), Bishop of La Paz (1633–1638), and Bishop of Popayán (1631–1633).
